db.title: Database structure
db.subtitle: Application tables of the project management · {count} tables

rights.title: Rights table
rights.subtitle: Which role may do what. The table is read from the rules of the app, so it always shows the truth.
rights.systemHint: Apply across the whole app, regardless of any project.
rights.projectHint: Apply inside a project, depending on the project role.
rights.readOnly: The role {roles} may change nothing, not even as owner of a project. | The roles {roles} may change nothing, not even as owner of a project.
rights.admin: The role {roles} may do everything, also in projects it is not a member of. | The roles {roles} may do everything, also in projects they are not members of.
rights.scrollHint: Not all roles fit: the table scrolls sideways.

names.OWNER_MANAGE: Grant or take away owner roles (roles with “delete the project”)
names.TASK_UPDATE_OWN: Change own tasks (the ones created by oneself)
names.TASK_ASSIGN_SELF: Assign oneself, or remove one’s own assignment
names.PROJECTS_VIEW_ALL: See all projects, even without membership
names.PROJECTS_MANAGE_ANY: Manage any project: all project rights in all projects

roleSettings.title: Roles and rights
roleSettings.intro: Rights are fixed by the code. A function bundles rights, a role bundles functions. System roles hold for a person in the whole app, project roles for a membership.

assignHint.PROJECT: Project roles are given in a project under “Members”.

roleSettings.capNone: Project rights: none, the person only reads in projects

roleUsage.SYSTEM: Nobody has the role | 1 person | {count} people
roleUsage.PROJECT: Given in no project | 1 membership | {count} memberships

roleSettings.functionUsage: In no role | In 1 role | In {count} roles
roleSettings.scopeHint: The scope cannot be changed later.
roleSettings.keyHint: The key is made from the English name and stays fixed afterwards.
roleSettings.capHint: Sets which project rights can take effect at all for people with this role, whatever their project role.
roleSettings.capRights: Project rights that may take effect
roleSettings.duplicated: “{name}” created. You can adjust it now.
roleSettings.deleteRoleDescription: The role will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
roleSettings.deleteFunctionDescription: The function will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
roleSettings.resetRoleDescription: Name, functions and cap go back to what ships with the app. This holds at once for everyone with the role.
roleSettings.resetFunctionDescription: Name and rights go back to what ships with the app. This holds at once for every role with this function.
roleSettings.creator: Creator

trash.hint: What was deleted stays here until someone deletes it for good. Restored items go to the end of their list.
trash.purgeDescription: “{title}” is deleted for good, with everything that went with it. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyDescription: {count} entry is deleted for good. This cannot be undone. | {count} entries are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
trash.projectPurgeDescription: All milestones, todos, tasks and comments of this project are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

planer.empty: The plan has no milestones yet.
planer.willDelete: Goes to the trash | {count} item goes to the trash | {count} items go to the trash

file.title: Planer file
file.intro: The whole project as a file in the planer-v2 format: milestones, to-dos, tasks, members and labels.
file.languageHint: Language of the Markdown view: fixed words and label names.
file.legendHint: The legend names the words in the other language too.
file.markdownFailed: The Markdown view is not possible.
file.importHint: Read a planer file into the project. You see what changes first; nothing is written until you confirm.
file.templateHint: The outline and the labels of this project as your own template, without members, due dates and assignments.
file.templateDescription: The template gets the labels, milestones, to-dos and tasks of this project. All tasks in it are “planned”.

import.title: Read in a planer file
import.intro: Choose a planer file (planer.json). Nothing is written yet: you see what would change first.
import.introNew: Choose a planer file (planer.json). You see what would be created first. You become a member of the new project.
import.notJson: This is not a valid JSON file.
import.notPlaner: This is not a planer file (format planer-v2).
import.modeFullHint: The file is the whole plan: what it lacks goes to the trash. The revision of the file must match.
import.modePartialHint: Adds and changes, never deletes. Fields the file leaves out stay.
import.errors: No error | 1 error, nothing is written | {count} errors, nothing is written
import.warnings: No warning | 1 warning, the import goes on | {count} warnings, the import goes on
import.warningsDone: One entry was not taken over, for example an assignment to an unknown email address. | {count} entries were not taken over, for example assignments to unknown email addresses.
import.nothing: The file changes nothing in the project.
import.confirmDescription: The file leaves out 1 item. It goes to the trash and can be restored there. | The file leaves out 1 item. It goes to the trash and can be restored there. | The file leaves out {count} items. They go to the trash together and can be restored there.

webhook.title: Notification on changes
webhook.intro: The app tells you when the planer file has changed, at most every five minutes. A GitHub Action can use it to keep the file in the repository up to date.
webhook.repositoryHint: In the form owner/name, for example oliver/podcast.
webhook.urlHint: The app sends a signed POST to this address (https only).
webhook.tokenHint: Fine-grained token, this repository only, permission Contents: write.
webhook.secretHint: The app signs the body with it (HMAC-SHA256, header X-Mollo-Signature).
webhook.removeDescription: The app no longer tells anyone about changes. The stored token or secret is deleted.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.intro: Your private ideas. Plan them later with the assistant or keep drafts here.
ideas.emptyDescription: Create an idea or keep a draft of the assistant here.

aiContext.title: AI context
aiContext.intro: Background knowledge for the assistant: goals, terms, scope. The assistant reads it as knowledge, never as instructions.
aiContext.textHint: Everybody in this project sees this text, and it is sent to the AI service (Claude) for evaluation. Do not enter passwords or confidential data.

file.size: The file is larger than 100 KB.

aiContext.shareHint: The context can then also be read through the access for Claude.

documents.title: Documents
documents.noneHint: Create the first document, for example a procedure or minutes.
documents.accessHint: Who in the project may read or change the document. You share it with single people afterwards.
documents.emptyContent: The document has no content yet.

draft.title: Restore the unsaved draft?
draft.text: You started changes on {date} and did not save them. The draft is in this browser.

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.text: If you leave the page, your changes are not saved. A draft stays in this browser.

conflict.title: The document has changed in the meantime
conflict.text: Somebody saved a newer version. Your changes are not saved and stay as a draft in this browser.

sharing.title: Share document
sharing.projectAccess: For all members of the project

documents.transferText: The new owner manages the document. You lose the management unless you have it for another reason.

versions.title: History
versions.restoreText: A new version with this content is made. Nothing is overwritten.

authorize.title: Continuing the login
authorize.text: One moment, you are being redirected.

consent.title: Allow access
consent.intro: {client} wants to work with your account (logged in as {name}).
consent.unavailableText: This request is no longer valid. Start the login in the application again.

errors.email_unverified: Confirm your email address first. Then you can allow applications.
errors.agent: An agent account cannot allow an application.
errors.not_approved: Your account has not been approved by an admin yet. This application needs the approval.
errors.other: No application can be allowed with this account.

consent.selfRegistered: This application registered itself and has not been checked by Mollo. After you allow it, you continue to {host}.
